comments.author: GrubbyApe
comments.body_html:
This won’t be relevant for anyone not using the 3.9.x version (5.3.2) but some extracts like Scav_Industrial_zone and Scav_Underboat_Hideout are misconfigured, and will crash the server with a mismatch error.

This is because they are configured as SCAV_Industrial_Zone and SCAV_Underboat_Hideout in “all-exfils.js”. Using these names will mean no crash, but the extracts don’t work since they don’t match the vanilla names.

Simply add Scav_Industrial_zone and Scav_Underboat_Hideout to the “lighthouse” array in “all-exfils.js” and use the proper names (Scav_Industrial_zone and Scav_Underboat_Hideout) in the config if you want to use them.
